name: DARK SOULS III

antiCheat.name: Online checks for changed files
antiCheat.note: No anti-cheat program on PC, but the servers flag changed game files. me3 also keeps the game offline.

notes: Steam 374320. Nexus domain darksouls3. me3 has an offline lock for Dark Souls III since v0.8 (NEWS.md).

me3 v0.13.0 (github.com/garyttierney/me3, releases 2026-08-11) starts Game/DarkSoulsIII.exe directly, without the anti-cheat starter, with mods from a Turbine-owned profile; nothing is placed in the game folder. Recheck on the device before shipping.
